prompts.concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new full-body Executioner / judge-knight female fantasy game character on a genuine transparent square canvas, requested 2048x2048.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 (old female Executioner) is a reference ONLY for her white medium-bob hair, purple eyes and refined facial identity; redesign the clothes, axe and pose to the user specifications below.
Image 2 (approved Sword Master) is the STYLE reference: match its clean Japanese 2D anime game illustration linework, coherent restrained shading and moderate detail. Do not copy his male face, red cape, leather outfit, weapon or pose.

USER-CHOSEN CHARACTER:
Woman in her EARLY THIRTIES, tall and slim with a toned athletic build, natural long limbs, small proportionate head, approximately 7.5–8 heads tall. Physical shoulder width approximately 1.5–1.75 face widths before clothing or armor bulk. WHITE medium bob reaching around shoulders, tidy natural hairstyle with coherent broad highlights. PURPLE irises. Light ivory skin, natural softly shaded complexion. Refined sharp neat beautiful facial features, calm cold professional NEUTRAL expression, closed mouth, no smile, no scowl. Clearly adult rather than a doll-like teen face.

COSTUME — halfway between a tailored formal SUIT and a KNIGHT'S ATTIRE:
BLACK tailored fabric jacket with clear lapels and structured waist; the jacket silhouette remains visibly formal. Integrate a few functional DARK SILVER / GUNMETAL armor plates: modest shoulder protection, simple forearm guards, and restrained lower-leg protection over fitted black trousers and dark boots. A simple dark silver fitted cuirass or upper torso armor is partially framed by the black jacket, with a small PURPLE neck accent and restrained purple fabric lining. Formal clean construction, coherent garment layering, an unobstructed natural neck and shoulder connection. Both legs in black fitted trousers. Moderate practical folds at elbows, waist and knees. The mix must read as a disciplined executioner-knight with tailored formality, not office clothes alone and not a bulky full plate knight. No helmet, huge pauldrons, giant cape, excessive ornaments, extra belts, dense engraving or glowing magic.

WEAPON:
Exactly one LONG-HANDLED AXE with a SIMPLE GENTLY CURVED CRESCENT-SHAPED BLACKENED STEEL BLADE, a straight DARK BROWN wooden shaft and one SMALL RED decoration near the axe head. No purple ornamentation on the axe. No giant baroque star guard, serrations, double axe, sword blade or hammer. Clear crescent axe silhouette, attached plausibly to the straight wooden haft. Preserve a substantial long-handled weapon proportion without dominating her body.
She carries the axe LOW beside her body with one hand naturally gripping the shaft near hip level; axe head near shin/ankle height, below the hand, pointed down and outward, fully visible beside her leg. The shaft must remain straight across the hand with no kink or bend. Natural hand, five fingers, coherent wrist, functional secure grip.

POSE AND FRAMING:
Both face AND torso turn together slightly toward the VIEWER'S LEFT in a restrained standing three-quarter view; keep both purple eyes readable and the neck naturally aligned. Calm balanced stance with subtle weight shift, other hand relaxed naturally at her side. Full head-to-toe body, all hair, boots and COMPLETE axe within the square. Character almost fills vertical canvas, minimal safe top/bottom transparent margin, no cropping. No exaggerated action or low camera angle.

STYLE:
Crisp continuous controlled 2D Japanese anime game illustration as image 2. Delicate face lines, outer contours slightly stronger than structural interior lines. Coherent broad hair shading with no repetitive light-dark bands or dense strands. Natural material shading, simple planar metal highlights and clean black fabric with moderate functional folds. No fixed two-tone limit. No grid, crosshatching, diagonal striping, noise, cloth weave, dense tiny wrinkles, plastic shine, photorealism, semi-realism or 3D rendering. No blurring or pseudo-detail from upscaling.
Exactly ONE character. Genuine ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, no scenery, floor shadow, pedestal, aura, labels, text, border or watermark. This is a new concept preview, not an overwrite of the existing project asset.

Precise LINEWORK WEIGHT edit. IMAGE 1 is the Executioner EDIT TARGET. IMAGE 2, the Viking, is ONLY a reference for outline weight and the clarity of boundaries at the same displayed character height.

The Executioner's current lines are too thin, gray and soft compared with the other game characters. Keep her exact design and make her linework visibly more confident and slightly bolder, matching image 2 as part of the same anime game illustration set:
- Strengthen the OUTER SILHOUETTE with clean continuous dark charcoal / near-black contours, moderately thicker than currently, approximately one clear step stronger. Keep natural taper and controlled thickness variation.
- Reinforce the major structural boundaries: white hair silhouette and broad hair clumps, jaw/neck outline, jacket lapels, sleeve edges, glove fingers, armor panel overlaps, trouser silhouette, boots, straight axe shaft and crescent axe head. Dark fabric must have readable defined edges.
- Keep interior linework lighter and more selective than the outer silhouette. Preserve delicate facial lines and clear purple eyes. Do not put uniformly thick black outlines around every facial feature or every small fold.
- Retain the present color palette and restrained shading; keep broad clean shading boundaries readable. Avoid broad airbrush softness around contours. Do not flatten away functional folds or add more wrinkles.

STRICTLY PRESERVE IMAGE 1: same adult woman in her early thirties, exact white medium bob, purple eyes, light ivory skin, sharp refined cold neutral face, same head size and tall slim athletic body proportions. Same slight face-and-body turn toward viewer LEFT, calm standing pose, both existing hands, fingers and grip. Same black tailored jacket and trousers, dark silver cuirass/shoulder/forearm/shin armor, purple neck accent and lining, black gloves and boots. Same single crescent-shaped blackened steel long axe, straight dark brown shaft and small red decoration, same weapon placement pointing down beside her body. Do not copy any male Viking anatomy, face, costume, fur, horned helmet, axe design or palette. No new accessories, armor pieces or decorations; do not change costume coverage, posture, facial expression or body shape.

Clean polished 2D Japanese anime illustration with stronger graphic linework, not photorealism, semi-realistic painting, 3D gloss, sketch hatching, noise, grid patterns or edge-sharpening halos. One complete full-body character on genuine TRANSPARENT square background, requested 2048x2048, minimal top/bottom margin, entire hair, feet and axe inside frame. No scene, ground shadow, aura, labels, text, borders or watermark. Change line strength only while preserving the character.
